headline: Video: Investor "Happy" as Prabowo Calls MSCI CEO to Discuss RI Market Status
summary: A CNBC Indonesia video reports an investor named Prabowo called the MSCI chief executive to discuss Indonesia's market status and prevent a standalone classification.
why: MSCI is a major index provider whose market classification decisions affect foreign investment flows into emerging-market stocks such as Indonesia's.
original_headline: Video: Investor "Happy" Prabowo Telpon CEO MSCI Bahas Status Pasar RI
